name: The Royal Sunset Orchids & Garden Roses
description: An opulent architectural arrangement inspired by the golden hour over the Abu Dhabi Corniche. Features rare peach Cymbidium orchids, flame-hued Ecuadorian garden roses, ranunculus, and sunburst chrysanthemums presented in a custom ribbed matte ceramic vessel.
origin: Flown in directly from Holland & Ecuador
includes: Handcrafted matte ceramic vase, signature satin ribbon, handwritten gold-foiled note card, flower food sachet

name: Emirates Sovereign Velvet Roses
description: The quintessential statement of regal elegance. Fifty hand-graded, long-stemmed Ecuadorian velvet roses in deep terracotta, crimson, and golden amber. Hand-tied with double-faced Italian silk ribbon and delivered in our signature Abu Dhabi luxury embossed hatbox.
origin: Cotopaxi High Altitude Volcanic Soil, Ecuador
includes: Signature luxury embossed cylindrical hatbox, bespoke wax-sealed calligraphy message, floral preservative

name: Saadiyat Dawn Peonies & Cream Lilies
description: Inspired by the serene morning light reflecting off the turquoise shores of Saadiyat Island. Layers of Dutch Sarah Bernhardt peonies, fragrant Casablanca lilies, apricot lisianthus, and silver-dollar eucalyptus in an alabaster fluted vase.
includes: Fluted alabaster glass vessel, hand-dipped beeswax seal, custom note card

name: Desert Amber Preserved Botanical
description: Preserved to retain their exquisite organic texture and radiant warmth for up to 3 years without water. Features preserved Tuscan garden roses, golden pampas grass, ruscus, and bleached Italian foliage set in a raw travertine stone base.
includes: Sculptural travertine stone urn, 3-year guarantee certificate, gift presentation packaging

name: The Al Maryah Grand Centerpiece
description: Designed specifically for prominent majlis tables, grand dining salons, and executive penthouses. An extravagant 360-degree display of burnt orange calla lilies, coral amaryllis, Dutch delphinium, and cascades of imported hanging amaranthus.
origin: Direct from Dutch & Italian Master Growers
includes: Heavy hammered brushed-brass pedestal vase, white-glove setup on delivery, personalized card

name: Yas Mirage Coral Ranunculus
description: Richly ruffled Clooni Ranunculus from the Sanremo Riviera paired with burnt amber spray roses and fragrant French sweet peas. A joyful, tactile arrangement that brings effortless warmth to bedside tables and intimate consoles.
includes: Smoked amber glass vase, signature embossed ribbon, personalized gift card

name: Al Bateen Gold Calla Lilies & Tulips
description: A masterclass in modern floral architecture. Twenty golden yellow Dutch Calla Lilies and French parrot tulips arranged with bent monstera foliage in a tall cylindrical smoked glass urn. Sleek, confident, and timeless.
includes: Architectural smoked glass column vase, floral hydration kit, handwritten gift card

name: Qasr Al Sarab Sunset Protea & Wild Orchids
description: An evocative tribute to the majestic Liwa desert dunes. King Proteas from South Africa, deep amber Mokara orchids, terracotta garden roses, and dried date palm sprigs created for the discerning art collector.
origin: Cape Floral Kingdom, South Africa & Thailand
includes: Hand-thrown terracotta and gold-leaf vessel, velvet ribbon, Abu Dhabi boutique presentation box
